statement.zh: **协议**：证书透明度（Certificate Transparency）。RFC 6962 §1 给出机制定义：「Certificate transparency aims to mitigate the problem of misissued certificates by providing publicly auditable, append-only, untrusted logs of all issued certificates.」它不阻断错误签发，只保证可被发现——「The logs do not themselves prevent misissue, but they ensure that interested parties (particularly those named in certificates) can detect such misissuance.」提交后由日志签发时间戳作为凭证：「When a chain is submitted to a log, a signed timestamp is returned」。
statement.en: **Protocol**: Certificate Transparency (证书透明度).RFC 6962 §1 defines the mechanism: "Certificate transparency aims to mitigate the problem of misissued certificates by providing publicly auditable, append-only, untrusted logs of all issued certificates." It does not block misissuance, only makes it visible: "The logs do not themselves prevent misissue, but they ensure that interested parties (particularly those named in certificates) can detect such misissuance." Submission yields a signed timestamp — "When a chain is submitted to a log, a signed timestamp is returned".

statement.zh: 两条设计理由。其一防滥用：「In order to avoid logs being spammed into uselessness, it is required that each chain is rooted in a known CA certificate.」其二把审计代价放到密码结构上：§2.1「Logs use a binary Merkle Hash Tree for efficient auditing.」§1 解释正是这棵树让追加只增可被证明——「The append-only property of each log is technically achieved using Merkle Trees」。检查还设计成异步以免拖慢握手：「The checking operation is asynchronous to allow TLS connections to proceed without delay」。
statement.en: Two design reasons.Spam resistance first: "In order to avoid logs being spammed into uselessness, it is required that each chain is rooted in a known CA certificate." Auditability second: §2.1 "Logs use a binary Merkle Hash Tree for efficient auditing." and §1 explains that the tree is what makes append-only provable — "The append-only property of each log is technically achieved using Merkle Trees".

statement.zh: 为在不预先签发的前提下记账，§3.1 引入预证书：「the CA submits a Precertificate that the log can use to create an entry that will be valid against the issued certificate.」并用毒化扩展使预证书不被普通校验接受；同节把预证书的签发意图视为有约束力——「misissuance of the Precertificate is considered equal to misissuance of the final certificate」。TLS 客户端一侧在 §5.2：客户端应校验 SCT 签名，且「TLS clients MUST reject SCTs whose timestamp is in the future.」监控者职责在 §5.3：「Monitors watch logs and check that they behave correctly.」。
statement.en: To account for certificates before issuance, §3.1 introduces the precertificate: "the CA submits a Precertificate that the log can use to create an entry that will be valid against the issued certificate." using a poison extension so ordinary validation rejects it, and treats intent as binding — "misissuance of the Precertificate is considered equal to misissuance of the final certificate".§5.2 covers TLS clients, which verify the SCT signature and "MUST reject SCTs whose timestamp is in the future." §5.3 defines monitors: "Monitors watch logs and check that they behave correctly."。.

statement.zh: 时间窗口是硬边界：§7.1 说没有有效 SCT 的错误签发证书会被客户端拒绝，而已有 SCT 的证书会在 Maximum Merge Delay 内出现在日志里，因此「the maximum period of time during which a misissued certificate can be used without being available for audit is the MMD.」日志自身可能作恶，§7.3 列出两种方式——不按时收录，以及「by presenting two different, conflicting views of the Merkle Tree」，并说明两类违反都可被公开检出：一旦同一日志出现两个冲突的签名树头，「this is cryptographic proof of that log's misbehavior.」。
statement.en: Time is the hard bound: §7.1 says misissued certificates without a valid SCT are rejected by clients, while logged ones surface within the Maximum Merge Delay, so "the maximum period of time during which a misissued certificate can be used without being available for audit is the MMD." Logs themselves may misbehave, and §7.3 lists two forms — missing the MMD, or "by presenting two different, conflicting views of the Merkle Tree" — both publicly detectable, since two conflicting signed tree heads for one log are "cryptographic proof of that log's misbehavior."。.

statement.zh: RFC 6962 于 2013 年 6 月发布，Category 标注 Experimental。§1 说明通用性与当时范围：「Note that this is a general mechanism, but in this document, we only describe its use for public TLS server certificates issued by public certificate authorities (CAs).」§2.1 记录哈希算法在该实验版本里固定为 SHA-256，并预期日后由日志自选算法；同节还注明叶子与节点的哈希不同，这一域分离「is required to give second preimage resistance.」。
statement.en: RFC 6962 was published in June 2013 with Category: Experimental.§1 fixes the scope: "Note that this is a general mechanism, but in this document, we only describe its use for public TLS server certificates issued by public certificate authorities (CAs)." §2.1 records that SHA-256 is fixed for this experiment with logs expected to choose their own hash later, and notes that distinct leaf and node hashing "is required to give second preimage resistance."。.
